notes.title: The demo version of Horrors Glade is already available!
notes.content:
Fans of survival horror got the opportunity to be the first to plunge into the gloomy atmosphere of a mysterious forest in the new demo version of the game Horrors Glade.
What the demo version offers:
• Explore an open world where every shadow can be dangerous
• Basic mechanics of crafting and resource extraction
• The opportunity to get acquainted with the survival and monster fighting system
• Test your skills in fighting hunger and fear

Management:
• WASD for moving
• Q/E for camera rotation
• Tab for inventory and crafting
• Left mouse button to attack and hack

The developers invite everyone to try out the demo version and share their opinion about the project. This is a great opportunity to evaluate the atmosphere and mechanics of the game in advance before the release of the full version.
Don't miss the chance to be the first to test your survival skills in the creepy atmosphere of Horrors Glade!

notes.title: Basic tips for survival in the forest "Horrors Glade"
notes.content:
[b]Basic Survival Tips[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45407581/a13c3f06a4ddc353ced77972f889932457f0bdbe.gif[/img]

Welcome to the exciting world of "Horrors Glade", a forest survival simulator full of dangers and mysteries! In this guide, we will share with you the secrets that will help you overcome the harsh conditions of this amazing place and create the main buildings that will become your faithful companions on this thorny path.

[b]Collecting resources[/b]

Constantly explore the surroundings in search of resources such as wood, rocks, plants and others. These materials will become the basis for creating tools and other items that will help you survive. Also, do not forget to check the area for animals — they can become a food source.

[b]Health and hunger Management[/b]

Your best friend is the indicator bar on the screen. Keep an eye on your health and hunger indicators to avoid negative consequences. Do not forget to eat regularly, eating apples, meat and other healthy foods.
Caution
Be careful and careful while exploring the forest. Avoid encountering dangerous creatures and traps to save your life and health. In the dark, use a torch or other light source to see what is ahead.
Crafting basic tools
In Horrors Glade, crafting is an essential part of survival. We will tell you about the most necessary tools and how to create them.

[b]Workbench[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45407581/6d3041882df517d3c7fe7b6df1bca03b33dfb00e.png[/img]

A workbench is an indispensable tool needed to build protective walls made of stone and craft anvils. To create it, you will need 5 ropes, 10 planks and 3 stone blocks.

[b]The oven[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45407581/2fedd1d2a6b892085ea025fd0a8f90a808d43209.png[/img]

Crafting a furnace requires 3 pieces of metal ore, a stone wall, and 4 planks. In this furnace you will be able to melt ore, which will greatly simplify the process of creating various items.

[b]The Anvil[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45407581/c4b9fc83c059f8707709eea318356d0629818174.png[/img]

The anvil is a key element for creating a variety of tools and weapons. To make it, you will need 7 pieces of metal ore.

By following these simple tips and creating the necessary tools, you will significantly increase your chances of survival in "Horrors Glade". Good luck and take care of yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45407581/2745294edaaa848462450079f46d888c69f8647a.gif[/img]

Don't forget to add the game to your wish list so you don't miss the release of the full version!
